sections.Profile:
The "Big Top" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in January 1964, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features four flippers, four pop bumpers, two passive bumpers, two slingshots, and four standup targets.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1964

- Type: Electro-Mechanical
